strategy: Use a scoped git revert before adoption or a new superseding Architecture package after adoption; never rewrite or delete historical authorities.
steps: Create a dedicated rollback task branch from the then-current protected base.
Revert OA-00 commits in reverse order if OA-00 has not been adopted, without force-push or history rewrite.
If v1.2 has been adopted, create a new human-directed Architecture version that supersedes it rather than editing adopted files in place.
Re-run canonical, cross-repository, governance, Ontology, JSON, Markdown, hash, graph, diff, and consumer checks.
Preserve v1.1, v1.2, ADRs, approvals, evidence, task graphs, manifests, and all P0 evidence as immutable history.
Open a Draft rollback PR and stop for human checkpoint.
